summary: Iteration 3 review-spec testing PASSED end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 new pytest cases in test_new_iteration3.py all pass (reverse geocoding, multi-use invite link, trip flow, nav-route regression). Full suite: 38 real assertions pass, 1 skipped (contact invitation hit plan cap = acceptable per spec), 1 fixture setup error caused by test-data accumulation on Ana's group (5 fixed-member cap; not a product bug). Frontend: (a) Login works, map-home shows bar-greeting 'Hola Ana' → within ~6s bar-prompt '¿A dónde vamos?'; no sharing-status-bar; no people-sheet. (b) fab-tools opens tools-menu with all 6 labels (Quedar, Convoy, Todo bien, Anti-cong, Actividad, Privacidad); map click closes it. (c) fab-sharing opens sharing-panel with 6 sharing-key-* rows, sharing-with visible, sharing-close visible, sharing-modify → /privacy → back to /map. (d) members-rail shows 4 rail-<member_id> avatars (Ana's own is one of them; note: no literal 'rail-me' testID, uses rail-<member_id> pattern — see action_items). (e) navigate flow: search-bar-input → /navigate, typed 'Gran Via' → 5 nav-result-*, picked #0, route-summary visible, nav-go → /drive?lat=…&place=… with real coords. (f) /drive with prefilled Puerta del Sol: drive-instruction 'En la rotonda, tome la cuarta salida en Avenida del General Perón', drive-eta 'en 200 m · 26 min · 7.3 km · llegada 18:22'; tool-stop → panel-stop, 5 stop-result-* for 'Gran Via', picking one updates ETA to '32 min · 8.6 km' and shows '1 parada'; tool-poi → panel-poi → poi-cafe → 5 poi-result-*; tool-group → panel-group with 'Viaje con Grupo 1'; fab-sharing opens sharing-panel; map click closes any panel; drive-close returns to /map. (g) /group/{gid}: invite-options + invite-link-whatsapp + invite-link-share + invite-from-contacts all present; contacts-picker opens with 'La agenda del dispositivo solo está disponible en la app móvil.' web-unsupported message; no crash. (h) Regression: /privacy, /profile, /meeting/new (prefilled 'Puerta del Sol'), /convoy/new all render without error-screen. api.ts single-flight refresh VERIFIED: page navigations trigger a burst of 401→refresh cycles (3-4x on /drive load) but the session persists and screens populate; no logout, matching the review's expectation. Web console warnings 'shadow*'/pointerEvents remain (known, ignorable). No red screens, no React Native errors, no deprecated Expo packages found.

routers/groups.py:178-191 – Multi-use invite-link endpoint is idempotent (find_one({multi:True,status:'open'}) then create if missing). Behaviour matches spec: second call returns same id/token. Confirmed.
routers/providers.py:236-255 – Reverse geocoding rejects NaN before calling Azure; returns Unavailable('service') → maps to 503 in ASGI handler. Confirmed.
components/MembersRail.tsx uses rail-${member_id} (line 19). Consider adding testID='rail-me' on the current user's avatar so it's addressable stably across sessions.

app/drive.tsx (via UI) correctly handles 401 bursts through api.ts single-flight refresh — verified by opening /drive right after login without reload: 3x 401s are followed by successful drive-instruction/drive-eta hydration, no logout redirect.
